My research develops robust econometric, Bayesian, and sequential methods for credit-risk model validation, monitoring, and stress testing.

## Publications

::: {.featured}
<span class="kicker">★ Featured paper</span>
<span class="f-title">A Bayesian Approach to Probability of Default Model Calibration: Theoretical and Empirical Insights on the Jeffreys Test</span>
<span class="authors">Christophe Hurlin and <span class="me">Yoann Pull</span></span> · <span class="venue">European Journal of Operational Research (accepted, 2026)</span>
<p class="summary">A Bayesian reappraisal of the Jeffreys test used by supervisors to validate probability-of-default calibration, with theoretical results and empirical evidence on when the test can be trusted for credit-risk model validation.</p>
<div class="links">
  <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0377221726004509" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Journal (EJOR)</a>

</div>
:::
